meta.title: The single stage screen opens on RFP with everything locked until a template is chosen

plan.title: Single-stage RFP locks controls before template

steps.note: Open the Events list from which Single Stage creation is reached.
Verify the events list rendered with its Create Event control and no error.
Open the Create Event menu and verify that Single Stage is offered.
Choose the Single Stage creation flow.
Verify the new Single Stage screen has RFP selected by default.
Verify Terms & Conditions is locked before a template is selected.
Verify the schedule control is greyed out before a template is selected.
Verify publishing is locked before a template is selected.

args.control: Search vendors you want to add

steps.note: Verify the participant vendor search is disabled before a template is selected.
Verify Single Stage does not provide a Save as draft button.
